note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, via the Exophase and PSNProfiles lists. Guides are original, written for this entry, with sources named per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then side characters, then collectibles and activities, and the platinum lands with the last one you finish. Keep this list open so nothing gets left behind.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Just play through it: follow the on screen prompts, do what the game asks, and the trophy pops at the end of the mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends on its own once the last mission of the chapter is done, and the trophy pops right after. If you are unsure where you are in the chapter, check the pause menu mission list: it shows which story missions remain.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Same as Chapter 1: play the missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. No side content is needed for it, just the story missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is wide open, so it is tempting to wander off into side content. That is fine, but the trophy only cares about the story missions: clear them and it pops.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last full chapter before the finale, so expect longer missions and bigger set pieces. Clear them in order and the trophy pops at the chapter end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play through to the end and finish the final mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4. The mission is long, so stock up on armor and ammo first, and use a manual save before you start it. The gold pops when the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission. Play it when it appears on the map and finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: if you rush past it, use mission replay from the pause menu to run it again and the trophy will pop.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a named story mission, a heist, so expect a setup phase first. Do the setups when they appear, then the heist itself. Finish it and the trophy pops. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: mission replay covers you if you need it again.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. Play it when it appears and finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: if it does not pop, replay the mission from the pause menu.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission. Play it when it appears and finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: mission replay from the pause menu is the fallback if it does not pop the first time.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission at Vice City International Airport. Play it when it appears and finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: replay it from the pause menu if you need another run at it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission. Play it when it appears and finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to one mission: mission replay from the pause menu is the fallback.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the long tail of the platinum: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the rest, all tracked in the pause menu stats screen. The stats screen is your checklist here: it shows every category and its percentage. Work the categories one at a time and this gold pops just before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts count whenever you pull one off: jumps, near misses, airtime, drifts and the like. The counter ticks up in free roam, so just drive fast and loose and it climbs. Fastest grind: find a long jump or a stunt ramp you like, hit it, reverse back, and repeat. The silver pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game: fishing, drone races, arcade games, shooting range, regular races, hunting, meditation, bowling and the stunt jumps. Try each one once and the trophy pops. You do not need to win or finish well, just try it. Do this early so you learn what each activity is before the big grinds.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges, and every one needs a gold medal. The range scores speed and accuracy, so pick a weapon you control well, aim for the head and chest zones, and reload between waves. Do the pistol challenges first to learn the timing, then the rifles. If a challenge keeps beating you, switch to a slower, steadier weapon and focus on clean hits over fast ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 spots around Leonida. Win one race at each spot. Drone races are about clean lines, not top speed: cut the corners, stay low through the gates, and do not crash, because a crash costs more time than a cautious line. Tick the locations off one by one on the map.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different means different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list on the map: street races, off road, boats and bikes all count. Bring the best vehicle for each race type, and use the racing line the game shows. 20 wins across the whole list is very doable once you stop repeating the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival. Find a fishing challenge against him, usually at a pier or on a boat, and outfish him. Fishing is timing: wait for the bite, hook it, then keep the line tension in the safe zone while you reel. Do not yank when the fish runs. Beat his catch total and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk into an arcade and finish any one game to its end. You do not need a high score, just a full playthrough of one cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the first machine you find, learn its controls in a minute, and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is a side character with his own mission strand. Play his missions as they appear on the map until his final one unlocks, then finish it. Flagged missable because his strand is a fixed chain: if you put it off, his missions stay on the map, but do them before the finale so you do not have to backtrack.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is a side character with his own mission strand, boat themed. Play his missions as they appear until his final one unlocks, then finish it. Flagged missable because his strand is a fixed chain: clear his missions when they show up rather than leaving them for after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is a side character with his own mission strand. Play his missions as they appear until his final one unlocks, then finish it. Flagged missable because his strand is a fixed chain: do his missions as they appear so the strand does not get left behind.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers show up as question marks on the map all over Leonida. Each one is a short mission strand. Finish 8 full strands. The trick is to check the map after every story chapter, because new strangers appear as the story opens up new areas. Do not leave them all for the end: spread them out and the silver comes naturally.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is a side character with his own mission strand. Play his missions as they appear until his final one unlocks, then finish it. Flagged missable because his strand is a fixed chain: clear his missions when they show up.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is a side character with his own mission strand. Play his missions as they appear until his final one unlocks, then finish it. Flagged missable because his strand is a fixed chain: do his missions as they appear.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, usually on hilltops, beaches and quiet overlooks. Visit each one and meditate. The spots show on the map once you get near them, so drive the map slowly and watch for the icon. Do a few per session while you are out doing other things and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is the hunting contact. He asks you to hunt a unique animal, a one of a kind specimen. Go to the hunting grounds he points you to, track it quietly, and take the shot when you have a clear line. Use a scoped rifle and stay downwind so it does not bolt. Bring the animal in and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered around Leonida, in shops, bars and hidden spots. A set is complete when you hold every card in it. Finish 3 full sets. Cards show in your collection menu, so check which sets are closest and hunt those cards first. Do not buy random packs hoping for luck: pick up the loose cards in the world, they are the ones that complete sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the tag and photo spot activity: find 100 marked locations and tag them. The locations spread across the whole map, so this is a long drive, not a quick job. Work region by region and let the counter build up as you explore. It pairs well with the exploration trophy, so do them together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the small goals the game tracks everywhere: driving, shooting, flying, stunts and more. The challenges menu lists them all with their progress. Finish any 50. Start with the easy ones (drive a distance, visit places, use a weapon) and the count rises fast. The hard ones can wait until the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, then a 4 star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the wanted level up in a quiet area, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until it drops. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present: do it during a mission or activity where your partner is with you, not alone in free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, and keep your wanted level the whole time. Pick 3 shops close together, plan the route first, and go in fast: rob, leave, next shop, no detours. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present and a clean run: do it when your partner is with you and the streets are quiet.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in it. There are well over 100 in the game, so this is about variety, not grinding: drive a different car every time you see one you have not sat in. The vehicle menu tracks what you have found. Hang around car parks, dealerships and busy streets and the count climbs fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow motion aiming mode. Trigger it when 5 or more enemies are in front of you, then drop all 5 before it ends. Best spot: a mission or a shootout with a group bunched together. Use a weapon with a big magazine so you do not reload mid focus, and aim for the chest to keep the shots fast.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport. An unscheduled departure means taking off in a plane without going through the normal flow: grab a plane on the tarmac and get it airborne. Flagged missable because it is a specific stunt at a specific place: go to the airport in free roam, find a plane, and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks. This one is about getting into one and causing chaos with it. Get a wanted level high enough that the army rolls in, or find a Rhino at a military spot, climb in, and drive it around. The trophy is about the tank itself, so just get in one and use it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and do not get spotted. That means no alarms, no witnesses calling it in, and no cameras catching you. Go in quiet, move fast, take the goods and leave before anyone reacts. Flagged missable because a detection ruins the run: save before you go in so you can retry clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, grab the cash and escape before the response arrives. Bring a fast getaway car and park it close. Do one vault per session so you are not rushed, and the silver pops at the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around the map. Find one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then escape. The truck stops are the easy part: block the road ahead of it with your car and it will halt. Grab the money fast and get out before the police box you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 areas to discover. Drive, fly or sail through each one and it ticks off. The map shows which areas you have been to, so check it and aim for the blank spots. This pairs perfectly with the WAiNK It and meditation grinds: do them on the same road trip and three trophies move at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, and each runs illegal operations. Rob one operation per gang. The operations show as targets on the map once you have found them, so work through the gangs one at a time. Hit the operation, take the goods and leave. One per gang is all it takes.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. Sit with it and enjoy the view and the trophy pops. Flagged missable because it is a specific moment at a specific place: do it on a visit to the beach rather than rushing past.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside it, and smash your way out through the glass in classic GTA style. Drive straight at the window and keep going. Flagged missable because it needs the right setup: pick a showroom with a big glass front and a clear run up to it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and bowl. Follow-through means completing your throw properly: line up, aim, and release clean. Play a full game and the trophy pops. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one alley: do it when you are nearby rather than leaving it for later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This is a partnership moment: do something with your partner that the game flags as a big shared win. It is tied to how you and your partner play together, so spend time doing activities as a pair and it will come. Flagged missable because it needs your partner with you: keep an eye out for it during partner missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one: it is about the choices you make across the game. Keep playing and making choices, story and side content alike, and the counter climbs. Flagged missable because it is tied to choices: do not skip the decision moments, and make a choice every time one is offered instead of walking away.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time is the charm: fail at something once, then succeed on the very next try. It is about the retry, so when something goes wrong, do not reload an old save: try again right away and pull it off. Flagged missable because it needs a fail followed by a success: let a small failure happen, then nail the retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is the strange event trophy: witness something weird out in the world. These moments are rare and random, so keep your eyes open while you roam, especially at night and in odd corners of the map. When something strange happens, stay and watch it play out and the trophy pops. Flagged missable because the event may not repeat: do not drive off when something odd starts.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means hitting someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line up a pedestrian, get the car moving, and swing as you pass. It takes a bit of aim: slow down to line it up, then speed through the hit. Flagged missable because it needs the right setup: pick a quiet street with a clear run and a pedestrian in the open.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts launder them for clean cash. Keep robbing and keep laundering: every vault, truck and shop job adds marked bills, and the laundering total climbs. The counter is cumulative, so it is a matter of time and steady crime, not one big score.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops, any shops. Clothes, weapons, ammo, food, car mods: it all counts. This one comes naturally if you play the game and buy what you need, but if you are short at the end, buy ammo and car upgrades in bulk. The counter is cumulative across every shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties to buy around Leonida. Each one shows on the map once you can afford it. Buy them all and the trophy pops. Garages are also useful: they store your cars, so buy them as you find them instead of saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the app for registering vehicles. Get in 10 different vehicles and register each one through the app. Any vehicle counts, so register the cars you drive every day and the ones you find parked around. 10 registrations is quick once you know where the option sits in the app.
